title: Chuunibyou demo Koi ga Shitai!: DEPTH OF FIELD - Ai to Nikushimi Gekijou
justification: AniList 15879 (SPECIAL, 7 episode(s) from 2012-12-19) is AniDB 8883's special(s) S8-S14, aired 2012-12-19 to 2013-06-19. AniList's PARENT relation names the parent entry, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 8883. The parent's row start 8 end 14 offset 13 puts S8-S14 on TVDB 0x21-0x27.
